class.name: IfcRelDefinesByTemplate
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelDefinesByTemplate defines the relationships between property set template and property sets. Common information about property sets, e.g. the applicable name, description, contained properties, is defined by the property set template and assigned to all property sets. Property set template that provides the common definition of related property sets. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.
